verdict.rationale: Plugins and skills run inside the built-in Codex and ChatGPT assistants, and users can hand them tasks. Documented examples include summarizing Slack channels and drafting replies, sending messages on the user's behalf, and scanning code for vulnerabilities. A built-in @plugin-creator skill scaffolds plugins for you, and a recorder drafts reusable skills from a demonstration. Community users report delegating real work through skills, such as writing tests, fetching Sentry info, and submitting PRs. missing for 10: hands-on evidence of delegated task outcomes and reliability, and documentation of how much autonomy the assistant has (background or long-running delegation, approval flow).
